test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The slant height of a cone is equal to twice the radius of its base. If the cone has a volume of 401π {~cm³}, find the magnitude of the cube of its base radius.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given **slant height** l = 2r, where r is the **radius**.

Height h = √(l² − r²) = √((2r)² − r²) = r√3.

Volume V = (1/3)πr²h ⇒ 401π = (1/3)πr²(r√3).

401 = (r³√3)/3 ⇒ r³ = (401 × 3) / √3 = 401√3.

**∴ The correct answer is 401√3 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Slant height (l) = 2 × Radius (r)

Volume of cone (V) = 401π cm³

**Formula Used:**

Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h

Relation between l, r, and h: l² = r² + h²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1d3fc1e9dc2d91f09991cdc595b4cac208e42d3ed323a9c6e70413e6dd6e415.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ h = √(l² − r²)

⇒ h = √((2r)² − r²) = √(4r² − r²) = √(3r²) = r√3

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × π × r² × (r√3)

⇒ 401π = (π × r³ × √3) / 3

⇒ 401 = (r³ × √3) / 3

⇒ r³ = (401 × 3) / √3

⇒ r³ = 401√3

**∴ The correct answer is 401√3 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cone

The total surface area is the sum of the curved surface area and the base area: TSA = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r).

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The lateral or curved surface area of a cone is given by the formula: CSA = πrl.

Equilateral Triangle Cross-section

When the slant height equals the diameter (l = 2r), the vertical cross-section of the cone through the apex is an equilateral triangle.</p
